These coincide only over algebraically closed k: 'all simples 1-dim' ⇔ 'B/Rad = product of copies of k', which is STRICTLY STRONGER than 'B/Rad commutative' over non-closed fields (e.g. ℂ as ℝ-algebra has commutative B/Rad but a 2-dimensional simple). All downstream consumers gate on IsAlgClosed k, so usage is sound, but the definition itself diverges from the book's literal statement.
